headline: Playmates released Toxic Crusaders toys in 1991
post:
Remember when R-rated movie properties were turned into children's cartoons? According to ComicBook.com, Playmates launched a surprisingly weird action figure line called Toxic Crusaders in 1991, tied to an equally brief thirteen-episode animated series. 

Since the manufacturer also created the massively popular Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, they likely hoped for a similar monster hit by leaning into a shared premise of a "mutant hero born out of toxic waste." While the original Troma source material was not kid-friendly, the line featured nine neon-colored figures like Nozone and Headbanger, complete with secret glow-in-the-dark weapons 🦠. 

Parents reportedly balked at the grown-up franchise being marketed to kids, leading to poor sales and a short shelf life. Today, however, those rare vintage pieces command high prices among dedicated cult collectors who embrace the sheer oddity of the era. 

What is your favorite obscure 90s toyline? 

#ToxicCrusaders #PlaymatesToys #RetroToys
original_title: One of the 80s’ Most Inappropriate Superheroes Somehow Got His Own Children’s Toy Line

headline: Doctor Doom views Storm as his equal
post:
Doctor Victor von Doom is known for his massive ego, but according to /Film, there is one Marvel hero he consistently views and addresses as an equal: Storm of the X-Men. 

Their complicated dynamic dates back to "Uncanny X-Men" #145. During this comic arc, Doom welcomed Storm to his castle as an honored guest and even conceded her self-styled title of "goddess." Although things quickly went sideways when Doom trapped her in a chrome statue, he later apologized to Ororo and asked to know her better. 

Years later, their unique history continues to be referenced in modern comics, including a recent dinner in Latveria where Storm bluntly told him, "Don't flirt, Victor." ⚡️

Would you want to see these two team up again?

#Marvel #Storm #DoctorDoom
original_title: This X-Men Character Is The One Marvel Hero Doctor Doom Respects The Most
